d: The latest edition of Autocar India Quick News covers five car launches and three two-wheeler updates. Highlights include the teased Volkswagen Virtus facelift, Mercedes-Benz GLC Electric launch, Range Rover SV Sawai Collection, Maserati GT2 Stradale and updated MCPura pricing. On two wheels, Hero introduces the Destini 110 Classique Edition, Kawasaki launches the Z650 S, and Ducati brings its Desmo450 EDX and MX Factory to India, expanding its off-road motorcycle portfolio.
